Presidential birth places, birth dates, death dates and location where each U.S. President died.John Adams Birthplace
John Adams was born on October 30, 1735 in what was Braintree (now Quincy), Massachusetts in the home of his parents. The original house is now part of the Adams National Historic Park. It is open to the public to visit.
George Washington Birthplace
George Washington was born on February 22, 1732 in Westmoreland County, Virginia at his family's Popes Creek plantation home. The house in which he was born was destroyed in a fire in 1779. The property is now part of the George Washington Birthplace National Monument and is open to the public to visit.
Scranton, Pennsylvania
Joe Biden was born at St. Mary's Hospital in Scranton, Pennsylvania. The original building shown in the photographs above is currently a school.
Caldwell, New Jersey
Grover Cleveland was born on March 18, 1837 in Caldwell, New Jersey in the home of his parents. His father was a Presbyterian minister in Caldwell at the time and the house provided for the pastor was referred to as a manse. The original building is now part of the Grover Cleveland Birthplace State Historic Site. It is open to the public to visit.
Cincinnati, Ohio
William Howard Taft was born on September 15, 1857 in Cincinnati, Ohio in the home of his parents. The original house is now part of the William Howard Taft National Historic Site. It is free and open to the public to visit.
Point Pleasant, Ohio
Ulysses S. Grant was born on April 27, 1822 in Point Pleasant, Ohio in the home that his parents were renting. The original house was moved to various locations before returning to its original site in 1936. The site is owned by the State of Ohio (Ohio Historical Society) and is open to the public to visit.
